service_python: discovered from launchctl print program= for gui/501/com.epic.transcript-api
restart_rule: Restart only when apply exits 0 and the JSON has ok true and wrote true. Dry-run exit 0 is not enough. The installer does not restart.
outside_backup_required_before_apply: sqlite3 backup snapshot of data/transcripts.db (not the live WAL/SHM)
data transcripts and both drift JSON files
plist path reported by launchctl print
installer_backup_is_not_the_data_backup: backups/screenshots-<UTC>/ stores only replaced source files. The outside DEST backup is insurance and is not a restore source.
wal_shm_note: data/transcripts.db-wal and data/transcripts.db-shm may change while SQLite is in use. That does not roll source files back and does not delete them.
note: sha256 of file bytes. The manifest file is copied but not hashed inside itself. parent_commit is the production diff baseline. github_pr_base_commit is main and must not be merged. The outside backup is not restored by this procedure.
